description.zh: 当Test标识为false或空时，AuthYears必填，单位为年，范围为\[1,100]，取值100表示永久授权。
description.en: The authorization duration. This parameter is required when the Test parameter is set to false or is left empty. Unit: years. Valid values: 1 to 100. A value of 100 indicates permanent authorization.

description.zh: 业务类型。不超过64字符。可用于对具体业务进行备注，例如可以取接入方不同的人脸使用场景，或者待交付的客户标识等。建议传入该参数。
description.en: The business type. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. You can use this parameter to add remarks for a specific business, such as different facial recognition scenarios of the requester or the customer identifier to be delivered. We recommend that you specify this parameter.

description.zh: 测试标识。为true表示使用测试授权，授权时长默认为30天；为false，则授权时长根据AuthYears进行授权。
description.en:
The test identifier. Valid values:
- true: Uses test authorization. The authorization duration is 30 days by default.
- false: The authorization duration is determined by the AuthYears parameter.

description.zh: 用户设备ID。不超过64字符。可用于标识具体设备，建议可以使用设备物理编号。建议传入该参数。
description.en: The user device ID. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. You can use this parameter to identify a specific device. We recommend that you use the physical device number. We recommend that you specify this parameter.

descriptions.zh:
请求方法：支持以HTTPS POST和GET方法发送请求。

> 授权key在30分钟内有效，且不可重复使用，建议在每次激活前重新获取。
descriptions.en:
Request method: Supports sending requests by using HTTPS POST and GET methods.

> The authorization key is valid for 30 minutes and cannot be reused. Obtain a new key before each activation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth create-auth-key --biz-type FACE_TEST --user-device-id 3iJ1AY_oHcu7mC69 --test false --auth-years 1 --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudauth CreateAuthKey --region cn-hangzhou --AuthYears 1 --Test false --BizType FACE_TEST --UserDeviceId 3iJ1AY_oHcu7mC69
